name: @gjsify/spiel-native-linux-x64
description: linux-x64 prebuilt native library + GObject-Introspection typelib for @gjsify/spiel-native. Installed automatically on linux/x64 as an optionalDependency of that package (ADR 0017) and skipped everywhere else. Contains no JavaScript.

platformsUncommitted.linux-x64: prebuilds.yml builds it in the Fedora container and its `commit-prebuilds` job commits it back; a developer host would bake that host's glibc floor into the artifact instead of the CI baseline
